result.rationale: The model defines `before_validation do self.host.sub!(...) end`; when host is nil (e.g., a create/update request where params[:embeddable_host][:host] is missing), `sub!` is called on nil, raising NoMethodError and producing a 500 instead of letting the format validation produce a 422 error. The diff contains no nil guard on host.
